name: KJELDAHL DIGESTION AND DISTILLATION UNIT
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Kjeldahl Digestion and Distillation Unit is heavily relied upon in food testing, agriculture, and environmental laboratories. It is used to safely break down complex organic structures using concentrated sulfuric acid to determine nitrogen, protein, and ammonia content. It combines digestion and distillation on a single sturdy frame with individual energy regulators for 3 or 6 tests.
features: Combined digestion and distillation unit in a single metallic frame
Available in 3-test and 6-test capacities (500 ml flasks)
Individual energy regulators for each heating mantle
Durable fiberglass net heating surface with Nichrome heating elements
Low energy consumption instrument requiring minimal maintenance
Available with or without high-quality glass apparatus

specifications.Heating Element: Nichrome heating element on Fiber glass net
specifications.Structure: Powder coated MS cabinet with vertical/horizontal rods & clamps
specifications.Glassware: Available with or without glass parts
